requiredFindings.title: Allow unavailable informational timing when no root was created
requiredFindings.problem: The new validator invariant requires rootReapedElapsedNanos to be non-null on a measured slot if and only if that slot carries settlement-unverified-platform. Every macOS measured slot must carry that reason. A launch failure before root creation has no root-reaping endpoint, but the retained failed slot is still required to contain this informational duration.
requiredFindings.impact: A truthful incomplete macOS batch with a failed-before-root slot is invalid under the declared validator invariant unless a nonexistent root-reaped duration is supplied. The nullable structural carrier cannot resolve the stronger invariant.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Make informational timing availability depend on actual root creation, observed reaping and valid monotonic timestamps. Keep the mandatory macOS platform reason and incomplete status, but permit null rootReapedElapsedNanos when that evidence is absent, with a typed failure or absence explanation. Keep known informational values even on failed runs when the root was actually reaped. Align the schema description, DESIGN and reference cases; add a retained macOS failed-launch slot with no root, null informational timing and the applicable reasons.
requiredFindings.evidence: Static counterexample against the failed-slot contract: DESIGN:967 keeps failed runs without filling or rerunning their slots; DESIGN:999 accepts run-failed with both defined quantities null. Apple documents launch errors that create no child. No runtime demonstration was executed.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Qualify or supersede the retained r11 settlement cases
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The r11 reference cases still accept unavailable Linux and macOS with every elapsed value known and describe root-reaped plus ECHILD as settled without a Linux qualifier. The operative r12 rules and new cases correctly reject those macOS conclusions. Restrict the old cases to Linux or mark their macOS branch superseded so the current reference suite has one expected result.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Attribute the OS-dependent rejection to the validator
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The new reference cases say the schema rejects a macOS row claiming within. The structural complete-row branch permits within and contains no OS-dependent condition; the semantic validator's mandatory macOS platform reason prevents that complete result. Move the macOS-within rejection under the validator heading. The schema does correctly reject rootReapedElapsedNanos on a complete row.

priorFindingAssessment.assessment: QD-35 declines macOS whole-tree settlement, nulls elapsedNanos through settlement-unverified-platform, carries root-reaped timing separately without median or budget use, and keeps macOS rows incomplete. The live-descendant and ordinary-run calibration cases exercise this decision. C2-Q0-R12-01 concerns availability of the new informational carrier, not the withdrawn settlement claim.
The ordinary inherited mount case is under expected complete, and unavailable Linux and macOS cases are under expected incomplete.

requestAssessment.newError: The new informational timing iff forces a value on a retained macOS launch-failure slot with no root-reaping event.

scopeAssessment: The full DESIGN/schema comparison fits the r12 response table: QD-35 and its informational carrier/nulling, platform limitation/OI-20, calibration headings and relevant reference cases. Linux settlement is unchanged. The Linux/D12 qualification wording is a current method limitation within the record's standing and D13 dependency, not a new accepted qualification authority.

verification.method: Static full DESIGN/schema comparison, current/retained hash and size checks, schema structure and reference inspection, failure-slot/nulling review, three independent review slices and primary Apple launch documentation.
